english.note: Use 要求 as the all-purpose noun for a person's forceful claim, a requirement, or an insistent request.
This is the all-purpose noun for something that must be met or supplied, including a technical system requirement.

examples.english: This job places a very high demand on English ability.
examples.traditional: 呢份工對英文能力有好高嘅要求。
examples.jyutping: ni1 fan6 gung1 deoi3 jing1 man4 nang4 lik6 jau5 hou2 gou1 ge3 jiu1 kau4

examples.english: This document spells out the system requirement.
examples.traditional: 呢份文件列明咗個系統嘅要求。
examples.jyutping: ni1 fan6 man4 gin6 lit6 ming4 zo2 go3 hai6 tung2 ge3 jiu1 kau4
